race.comment: ALABAMA DANCE (11) made an encouraging return at Geelong when missing by a head over 1100m. Is sure to have come on from that and draws well again. Can go one better. WHAT A RIPPER (10) is a gelding by Capitalist from the stakes-winner Ripper Rita on debut. Has jumped out well in readiness and can run a big race. ISLE OF MONA (12) finished a narrow second when resuming here last time. Fitter and gets the blinkers applied. They could prove the trick. CORE BUSINESS (9) is a Written Tycoon Colt on debut for the Maher yard. Has come along nicely at the jumpouts and can make a bright start. Allen's booking is a good push too.
